title: What is SRE for Data? Reliability Engineering for Pipelines

scenes.heading: SRE for Data
scenes.narration: Site Reliability Engineering treats the health of your data pipelines as an engineering problem, not a firefighting hobby.

scenes.heading: What SRE brings to data
bullets: Treats reliability as a measurable feature, not an afterthought
Uses objectives and error budgets to balance speed and stability
Automates toil so engineers solve problems instead of repeating them
Learns from incidents through blameless postmortems
scenes.narration: Reliability becomes a feature you measure rather than something you hope for. Error budgets let you balance shipping speed against stability with hard numbers. Automating repetitive toil frees engineers to fix root causes instead of clicking the same buttons nightly. And blameless postmortems turn every failure into durable learning.

scenes.heading: Software SRE vs Data SRE
scenes.narration: Classic SRE watches whether a service answers requests quickly and stays up. Data SRE cares whether the data is fresh, complete, and correct when it lands. A pipeline can run green and still deliver wrong or stale numbers, so data reliability adds correctness on top of availability.

scenes.heading: The reliability loop
scenes.narration: Reliability work runs as a continuous loop rather than a one-time project. You define objectives, instrument the pipeline, and detect problems before users do. Then you respond, mitigate, and feed lessons back into better objectives and stronger safeguards.

scenes.text: Data SRE makes pipeline reliability measurable, automatable, and improvable — so trustworthy data becomes the default, not a lucky outcome.
scenes.narration: The goal of data SRE is simple: make trustworthy, timely data the default outcome instead of a lucky one.
